name: agent-loop-sidecar-stdio-crash
about: PILOTDECK_AGENT_LOOP_TRANSPORT=stdio，sidecar 换成一个只会握手、接下 execute（回 streamId）就往 stderr 写一行并以退出码 4 退出的脚本：执行已被接受后传输中断。基线（agentLoopSidecarClient.ts:693-713、999-1031）先在会话 .jsonl 记 agent_loop_operation_started / accepted，再记 outcome 为 result_unknown 的 agent_loop_operation_terminal（code TRANSPORT_INTERRUPTED、error 为序列化的传输错误），本地账本对不上已知终态，轮次以原始传输错误失败。binding 与 streamId 是脚本里写死的，两侧一样。标题请求延迟 1.5 秒，让标题记录稳定落在失败记录之后。

files.proj/crash-sidecar.sh:
read -r line
id=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/.*"kind":"request","messageId":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
printf '{"kind":"response","messageId":"hello-fake","inReplyTo":"%s","ok":true,"protocolVersion":"2.0","moduleId":"pilotdeck-agent-loop","moduleInstanceId":"fake-instance","connectionGeneration":"fake-instance-generation","capabilitiesVersion":"1","payload":{}}\n' "$id"
read -r line
id=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/.*"kind":"request","messageId":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
printf '{"kind":"response","messageId":"capabilities-fake","inReplyTo":"%s","ok":true,"protocolVersion":"2.0","moduleId":"pilotdeck-agent-loop","moduleInstanceId":"fake-instance","connectionGeneration":"fake-instance-generation","capabilitiesVersion":"1","payload":{"capabilitiesVersion":"1","methods":[{"name":"execute","enabled":true,"profiles":["streaming"],"cancel":true,"resumeSupport":"none","retry":"retry_after_status"},{"name":"cancel","enabled":true},{"name":"status","enabled":true},{"name":"resume","enabled":false},{"name":"ack","enabled":false}]}}\n' "$id"
read -r line
id=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/.*"kind":"request","messageId":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
req=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/.*"operationId":"[^"]*","requestId":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
printf '{"kind":"response","messageId":"accepted-fake","inReplyTo":"%s","requestId":"%s","ok":true,"streamId":"stream-fake","cursor":0}\n' "$id" "$req"
echo "fake sidecar gone" >&2
exit 4
